message.content:
We need
\[
617n \equiv 943n \pmod{18}.
\]
Subtract \(617n\) from both sides:
\[
(943-617)n \equiv 0 \pmod{18}.
\]
\[
326n \equiv 0 \pmod{18}.
\]
Now \(\gcd(326,18)=2\), so divide the congruence by 2:
\[
163n \equiv 0 \pmod{9}.
\]
Since \(\gcd(163,9)=1\), this requires
\[
n \equiv 0 \pmod{9}.
\]
The smallest positive such integer is
\[
n=9.
\]

The answer is 9.
